items.title: Bitcoin slips under $80,000 as traders de-risk ahead of Fed meeting
items.summary: Ether and XRP led losses among the majors as the AI trade took another hit in Asia, where Goldman Sachs cut its Kospi target by 25%.

items.title: Foundation Links Passport Phishing Emails to Compromised Cloudflare API Keys
items.summary: Recipients reported personal and purchase details in the messages; the company said Passport hardware and funds were safe.

items.title: Hong Kong names Nasdaq-listed Solana Company a strategic enterprise
items.summary: The Nasdaq-listed firm said it plans to establish Solana validator operations in Hong Kong.

items.title: CoinDCX confirms $16 million loss from retired wallets days after CEO called breach reports a ‘false alarm’
items.summary: CEO Sumit Gupta had told X users on Wednesday that early reports of a breach sounded like "a false alarm."
